image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a circular aneroid barometer with a gold-colored metallic casing. The dial face is brass-toned and features two concentric scales: an outer scale for atmospheric pressure in inches of mercury (marked 28-31) and an inner smaller dial for relative humidity (0-100%). It has black numerical markings, weather condition text ('Rain', 'Change', 'Dry'), and two pointer hands (one red-tipped for pressure, one black for humidity). The brand name 'GENERAL' is visible in the center.
